title: Place Media Forge assets in a ControlDeck project output grant
description: Commit one immutable Media Forge asset into a ControlDeck project output grant. Request the grant immediately before placing, not before generating: generation takes tens of seconds and a grant obtained early is likely to expire. If placement fails with an expired grant, acquire a new one and retry once. Media Forge never receives or accepts a filesystem path.

asset_id.description: An existing Media Forge asset. Assets are immutable, so placement always commits exactly the bytes that were generated and inspected.

output_grant_id.description: Opaque grant from ControlDeck. Obtain it directly before this call.

filename.description: Destination file name only, no directory separators. Choose it from the project's own conventions before requesting the grant.

oneOf.title: A batch of placements under one grant
oneOf.description: Place several related assets in one call. Every destination name is settled before the first byte is written, so a duplicate name or a missing asset is refused with nothing committed. The batch is NOT all-or-nothing: ControlDeck commits one file atomically, so a batch of N is N separate commits and the response reports each outcome.
